subject: Onboarding & clearance — consolidated verification export request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: backgroundchecks@hirefast.io
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding & clearance — consolidated verification export request

Hi Sarah / HireFast team,

We have an upcoming SIG/SOC2 spot check and our auditors have asked for a compact export that shows recent onboarding/clearance evidence for hires between 2026-12-01 and 2027-05-15. Specifically we need: 

- A roster CSV with employee id, hire date, role, last background-check date and result (redacted PII: show hashed SSN/ID and date of birth as year only).
- Summary of background-check findings (one-page PDF per group) with sensitive details redacted.
- Training completion log for security onboarding (course id, completion date, trainer id).

Requirements: the auditor needs the files delivered via a secure transfer (preferred: pre-auth Google Drive link with view-only, or SFTP). Please confirm:

1) You can produce the roster CSV with hashed identifiers and DOB year only.
2) The bg_check summary will include verdicts and categories (Clear / Consider / Escalated) and be redacted.
3) ETA for delivery — auditors want this by 2027-05-21 EOD Pacific.

We will upload anything we receive to the audit folder and provide the link to Barclift. If there are fees for this export, note them in your reply.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

[attachment: none yet]

From: Sarah Maddox <backgroundchecks@hirefast.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-18T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding & clearance — consolidated verification export request

Hi Jonas and team,

Thanks — we can produce the exports you described. Quick clarifying notes before we generate the files: 

- Roster CSV: we will include columns: employee_id, email (redacted to domain***), hire_date, role, bg_check_date, bg_result, id_hash (SHA256). We'll replace DOB with birth_year.
- BG summary PDF: a single combined PDF with one-page per candidate group (engineering, ops, sales) summarizing findings and any open escalations. We will redact specific criminal records details per your instruction and only include categorizations.
- Training log: we can include course code, completion_date, and trainer_email (redacted).

Delivery options: we can upload a password-protected ZIP to your Drive folder or provide an SFTP drop. For Drive, please share the folder ID and we will upload as: clearance_roster_202705_export.csv, bg_check_summary_redacted.pdf, training_completion_202705.csv

ETA: we can prepare the files and deliver by 2027-05-21 15:00 PT. There is a one-time export processing fee of $250; let us know if we should proceed.

Regards,
Sarah Maddox
Client Success Manager
HireFast Background Services

Two user requests from our side: 
- Laura: for any records with open escalations, include a one-line explanation (no PII), e.g., "Escalation: adverse media — under review".
- Vivek: ensure the CSV uses UTC timestamps for dates and UTF-8 encoding.

Approving the $250 export fee. Please confirm when upload completes and paste the file names and checksums in your reply.

Jonas

Jonas / team,

Files uploaded to the folder you provided (Drive link above). Delivery summary: 

- clearance_roster_202705_export.csv (CSV, UTF-8) — 2,143 rows — SHA256: a3b9f7e46d2c...
- bg_check_summary_redacted.pdf (PDF) — Combined summary, 9 pages — SHA256: f72c9a1b9e7e...
- training_completion_202705.csv (CSV) — 2,143 rows — SHA256: 9b1c3d2e7a4f...

Notes: 
- DOB values supplied as year only.
- id_hash column is SHA256 of the employee id salted with your org id (we used salt: REDWOOD2027).
- Three records flagged as "Escalated" (rows 118, 526, 1307) — each entry includes the short tag "Escalation: pending vendor follow-up". We did not include any sensitive adjudication text per your redaction request.

We also attached a short CSV manifest in the folder that lists the checksums and file sizes. If Barclift or your internal audit team needs additional redaction or a different hash scheme, let us know and we can reprocess.

Regards,
Sarah Maddox
HireFast Background Services
